author: Ed Crocker
description:
Horror is constantly innovating, and so is Rachel Harrison. After an unprecedentedly outrageous five year run of “horror of the year” contenders, in her newest, Kiss Slay Replay—out early September from Berkley (US) and Titan (UK)—she tackles her most structurally ambitious book yet: a time loop horror.
